rows.note: Use 預計 as the all-purpose verb for expecting a future event in advance, without emphasizing excitement.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jyu6 gai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 sak1 ce1

rows.note: Choose 期待 when the anticipation involves eagerly looking forward to something rather than merely predicting it.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 kei4 doi6 ting1 jat6 ge3 leoi5 hang4
